author: Jennijulia

title: Does what it says on the tin
body: The app works well and does what I need it to. Good design and functionality. In terms of improvements that could be made, it would seem more professional and polished if the texts within the app were edited by a native English speaker. I noticed immediately that they hadn’t been and was a little surprised by it.
author: cashewnut91

title: Okay but feels a little incomplete
body:
Great overview page, minimalist design and intuitive ui.

I would improve the widgets to be a little more compact (fit in more buttons per row) and add icons to habits and more color options. 

Also an apple watch app that offers the same functionality as the widget window would be very nice.

Will buy premium after these updates!
